attributes.title: PharmaCon27
attributes.venue: Hilton Hawaiian Village Waikiki Beach Resort
attributes.summary:
GAPNA's PharmaCon27 takes place April 6 to 10, 2027, at the Hilton Hawaiian Village Waikiki Beach Resort in Honolulu. The conference is built around pharmacology for nurse practitioners and clinical nurse specialists caring for older adults in primary and specialty settings.

Attendees can earn up to 18 ANCC contact hours, all of which count as pharmacology. Full registration costs $329 for members and $459 for nonmembers through February 9, 2027 (postmark), then $409 and $539; the on-demand package has the same early rates and a one-day in-person pass is $102 or $180. The discounted hotel rate is available through March 4, 2027, and written refund requests are accepted until February 23, 2027.
